how:
NP=$(echo "$NO_PROXY" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -vE '^(pypi.org|files.pythonhosted.org|registry.npmjs.org)$' | paste -sd,)
NO_PROXY=$NP no_proxy=$NP pip install --break-system-packages pyarrow
npm ... --noproxy='' --https-proxy="$HTTPS_PROXY"
name: PyPI and npm
note: Installs last only for the session.
what: pip and npm work, but only through the proxy: the registries sit on NO_PROXY and direct DNS fails. Installed pyarrow 26 this way, so parquet works for the session.
